name: splash-code.tar.gz
command: tar -C / -cf - usr/bin/app_resume usr/bin/boot_splashscreen usr/bin/launch_splash.sh usr/bin/app-boot-manager | gzip -1

name: splash-state.txt
command:
date -u
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id /proc/uptime
systemctl list-units --all --no-pager | grep -Ei 'splash|resume|app-boot'
grep -R -n -E 'boot_splash|app_resume|launch_splash' /usr/lib/systemd/system /etc/systemd /opt/etc/systemd/oneservice 2>/dev/null
ps -eo pid,ppid,comm,args | grep -E 'splash|resume|MiniHub'
true
